nodes.objective: Establish repository truth, capability and input inventories, evaluator boundaries, task graph, and resumable control state.
nodes.evaluator: Project OS validators, public mutation proof, JSON Schema task-result validation, independent sweep
nodes.acceptance: All M00 artifacts exist; known-bad public candidate fails; graph is acyclic; unsupported sealed/hidden claims remain gated.
nodes.rollback: Revert the initial bootstrap checkpoint and return to the verified Project OS archive.

nodes.objective: Establish the machine-verifiable autonomous-frontier contract, strict tri-state evaluator, proof ceilings, external-block semantics, and adversarial meta-tests.
nodes.evaluator: Strict JSON Schema, current command replay in isolated copies, proof-ceiling checks, and known-bad frontier meta-tests.
nodes.acceptance: All mandatory domains have stable gates and exact evidence/evaluator/command/known-bad/blocker contracts; false PASS/BLOCKED cases fail; current repository correctly evaluates FAIL.
nodes.rollback: Revert FRONTIER-001 artifacts and restore the preceding RESEARCH-001 checkpoint without changing mission or evidence claims.

nodes.objective: Close public Stage-1 source and mechanism gaps and create a claim-evidence graph.
nodes.evaluator: Primary-source provenance, counterevidence, classification completeness, independent metadata/schema reproduction, and executable research known-bads.
nodes.acceptance: Every decision-changing public claim is supported, rejected, or converted to an exact gate, and all four exact final research artifacts pass both research-closure and autonomous source-feasibility checks.
nodes.rollback: Restore the last accepted research registry and quarantine evidence with changed provenance.

nodes.objective: Activate a separately owned sealed evaluator repository and signed attestation workflow.
nodes.evaluator: Custody/access-control audit plus tamper, fixture-disclosure, expected-result mutation, and known-bad meta-tests.
nodes.acceptance: Builder cannot read/write/administer/bypass sealed cases; signed status binds application SHA and evaluator digest.
nodes.rollback: Restore the last custodian-signed evaluator digest and invalidate attestations after drift.

nodes.objective: Freeze exact-ten/abstention, value-first, feasibility, estimand, baseline, metric, and oracle contracts.
nodes.evaluator: Public properties, sealed adversarial pack, and bounded exhaustive differential tests.
nodes.acceptance: Deterministic output is exactly ten distinct eligible physical locations or abstention; all invariants and claim ceilings hold.
nodes.rollback: Keep the prior oracle addressable and block issuance on version mismatch.

nodes.objective: Create canonical versioned data, identity, decision, event, lineage, and replay schemas.
nodes.evaluator: Schema compatibility plus malformed grain, clock, lineage, and leakage cases.
nodes.acceptance: Entity grains remain distinct and every product records owner, version, clocks, hash, quality, lineage, and replay identity.
nodes.rollback: Use additive versioning and preserve the prior reader/schema version.

nodes.objective: Build the first synthetic source-to-route-to-field-outcome replay slice before horizontal expansion.
nodes.evaluator: Public integration/replay tests and custodian-owned temporal, protection, and mutation cases.
nodes.acceptance: A source fixture produces normalized evidence, distinct entity/location, candidate, score, exact-ten/abstention, manifest, outcome fixture, and matching replay.
nodes.rollback: Remove the slice modules and retain contracts/evaluator; no live effect exists.

nodes.objective: Implement synthetic F9 outcome, observation-window, maturity, censoring, competing-event, adjudication, and lineage contracts.
nodes.evaluator: Immature/censored-negative, duplicate, post-window rewrite, appointment-versus-value, and label-lineage mutations.
nodes.acceptance: Synthetic label mechanics reach level 5 while real maturity and outcome claims remain externally gated.
nodes.rollback: Revert the label contract/version and invalidate dependent synthetic outcome fixtures.

nodes.objective: Build incumbent, random, rule, recency, and simple statistical baselines behind replaceable point-in-time model interfaces.
nodes.evaluator: Common synthetic splits/metrics, leakage cases, baseline completeness, replacement criteria, and complexity mutations.
nodes.acceptance: Every candidate model is compared to meaningful baselines without exceeding synthetic proof level 5.
nodes.rollback: Retain the prior transparent baseline and disable any model version that fails common evaluation.

nodes.objective: Implement calibration, interval/uncertainty, missingness, subgroup, temporal sensitivity, and abstention propagation contracts.
nodes.evaluator: Reliability/coverage properties, uncertainty extremes, subgroup aggregation traps, and point-estimate-only mutants.
nodes.acceptance: Synthetic calibration mechanics reach level 5; historical reliability remains unclaimed.
nodes.rollback: Revert calibration version and fall back to bounded baseline uncertainty or abstention.

nodes.objective: Implement symbolic risk-adjusted expected net commercial value, cost, downside, and sensitivity machinery without inventing firm inputs.
nodes.evaluator: Distributional sensitivity, omitted-cost, modeled-versus-realized, uncertainty, and fallback-policy tests.
nodes.acceptance: A level-5 synthetic ECV engine accepts only versioned authoritative economics and preserves the level-9 realized-value ceiling.
nodes.rollback: Disable the ECV policy and retain transparent component outputs and sensitivity-only ranking.

nodes.objective: Harden the thin slice into replaceable application/module/API boundaries and a representative workflow that cannot bypass policy or lineage.
nodes.evaluator: Boundary, state-machine, manual-edit, duplicate-issuance, abstention-reason, accessibility, and error-path tests.
nodes.acceptance: Deterministic product workflow and architecture reach level 4 without claiming usability or field adoption.
nodes.rollback: Return to the executable thin-slice interfaces and remove the product workflow layer.

nodes.objective: Implement threat model, data classification, least privilege, privacy/retention, untrusted-input isolation, and negative authorization tests.
nodes.evaluator: Secret, PII log, prompt-instruction, unauthorized write, live-default, retention, and deletion mutations.
nodes.acceptance: Public security/privacy readiness reaches level 4 with live permissions still false.
nodes.rollback: Disable affected adapters/surfaces, revoke credentials when applicable, and return to no-live-write mode.

nodes.objective: Implement complete non-sensitive source/snapshot/identity/feature/model/policy/route/evaluator/outcome lineage and correlated events.
nodes.evaluator: Lineage completeness, missing as-of/version/hash, correlation, replay identity, and sensitive-log mutations.
nodes.acceptance: Every synthetic decision is traceable and replay-addressable without exposing sensitive payloads.
nodes.rollback: Revert event/lineage version while preserving the prior manifest reader and historical events.

nodes.objective: Prove deterministic replay, idempotency, backup/restore, compatibility, migration, rollback, and crash recovery.
nodes.evaluator: Replay mismatch, duplicate effect, partial crash, old snapshot, forward/backward migration, restore, and rollback cases.
nodes.acceptance: Synthetic recovery/replay reaches level 4/5 without production durability claims.
nodes.rollback: Restore the prior schema/reader and recovery baseline; block incompatible writes.

nodes.objective: Run the connected mutation/property/leakage/malformed/source/identity/route/uncertainty/fault/recovery campaign and repair surviving causes.
nodes.evaluator: Registered mutation threshold, survivor ledger, negative controls, fault injection, and independent adversarial sweep.
nodes.acceptance: No hard-invariant or material system mutant survives and no evaluator is weakened.
nodes.rollback: Revert the faulty implementation or evaluator change and restore the last passing campaign digest.

nodes.objective: Prepare schemas, adapters, authority/attestation templates, preregistrations, aggregate-only interfaces, contamination controls, and rollback for every external evidence stage.
nodes.evaluator: Placeholder-owner, fabricated credential, expiry/revocation, hidden leakage, post-hoc endpoint, maturity, and rollback mutations.
nodes.acceptance: Every external gate is exact and synthetically testable while remaining explicitly unclosed.
nodes.rollback: Revert the affected protocol/template version and keep external access disabled.

nodes.objective: Run three independent sweeps per round until two successive complete post-repair rounds find no critical/high issue or defensible positive-value change.
nodes.evaluator: Reviewer independence, domain coverage, severity ledger, repair chronology, two-round, stale-sweep, and no-positive-value checks.
nodes.acceptance: Mechanical convergence evidence satisfies AF-CONVERGENCE-SWEEPS-001; external empirical proof remains separately classified.
nodes.rollback: Invalidate sweep rounds predating a material repair and resume from the affected task.

nodes.objective: Acquire and map an authorized immutable representative source sample.
nodes.evaluator: Count/schema reconciliation, raw-byte hashes, replay, provenance, and poisoned-content cases.
nodes.acceptance: Authorized bytes are immutable and transformations are replayable without treating retrieved instructions as authority.
nodes.rollback: Stop the connector, quarantine data, preserve provenance and tombstones, and revoke credentials when applicable.

nodes.objective: Implement synthetic temporal identity, alternative-link, ambiguity, and fail-closed protection primitives.
nodes.evaluator: Alias, suite/unit, relocation, franchise, parent/subsidiary, temporal, and conflict cases.
nodes.acceptance: No grain collapses and ambiguity blocks live eligibility.
nodes.rollback: Revert identity version and invalidate affected candidate snapshots.

nodes.objective: Calibrate identity and protected-account behavior on authorized samples.
nodes.evaluator: Blind/adjudicated entity audit and protected false-clear measurement.
nodes.acceptance: Protected false-clear count is zero on the protected evaluation set and unresolved conflicts fail closed.
nodes.rollback: Restore the previous rule/model and block affected candidates/routes.

nodes.objective: Calibrate operational feasibility, route matrices, reserves, and substitutions while preserving business-value priority.
nodes.evaluator: Reference matrices plus infeasible, asymmetric, stale-duration, and substitution cases.
nodes.acceptance: Exact-ten/abstention survives operational constraints and matrix/as-of lineage is complete.
nodes.rollback: Use the last approved matrix adapter or abstain; never silently substitute straight-line distance.

nodes.objective: Calibrate and approve the risk-adjusted commercial decision policy.
nodes.evaluator: Point-in-time baselines, calibration, uncertainty, route/economic sensitivity, and rollback tests.
nodes.acceptance: Policy beats meaningful baselines at the supported proof level without overstating causal or commercial value.
nodes.rollback: Disable the policy version and use the prior approved policy or abstention.

nodes.objective: Run prospective non-influencing shadow operation and prepare—but do not self-authorize—the randomized route-day trial.
nodes.evaluator: External hidden holdout attestation, prospective replay, maturity monitoring, and preregistered analysis recovery.
nodes.acceptance: Shadow evidence reaches level 7; randomized and commercial claims remain blocked until levels 8 and 9.
nodes.rollback: Disable the policy version, preserve snapshots, and return to the prior approved shadow policy.
